title: Ecru opens chili cook-off registration and unveils student-painted rocks for December hunt
excerpt: Cooks can enter free for the Dec. 3 event at Pannell Park. North Pontotoc High School art students painted the rocks residents can look for around town throughout December.
locality: Town of Ecru, Pontotoc County, Mississippi.

paragraphs.text: Ecru is taking entries for a chili cook-off that will follow the 6 p.m. Christmas tree lighting Thursday, Dec. 3, at Pannell Park. Entry is free, but cooks need to register in advance. Local churches will sing carols in the park that evening.

Teams will have tables, tasting bowls and utensils at the park. They will need to plan how to keep their chili warm without an electrical hookup. The town says it will provide no electricity, a condition cooks are asked to acknowledge on the registration form.

The form asks how many people will participate on each team and approximately how much chili they expect to bring. Cooks can use the registration link below. Residents can also come to hear the carols and watch the lighting without entering a pot of chili.

There is something to look for outside the park as well. North Pontotoc High School art students painted rocks for a scavenger hunt that will run around Ecru throughout December. In a photograph the town shared Saturday, a white snowflake fills a dark-blue rock and a snowman in a black hat stretches across a gray one.
